rows.vgi.doc_llm: Read-only professional tennis data for the ATP and WTA tours: singles and doubles rankings, live and daily scoreboards, season calendars with champions, full draw results with set-by-set scores, Grand Slam finals, player profiles and player season logs. Start with the current tables for today; the functions take a tour ('ATP' or 'WTA') plus a season, day, tournament or player. WTA data comes from the official WTA API (WTA ids); ATP data and the cross-tour scoreboards come from ESPN (ESPN ids). Every row carries a source column naming its id space; ids from one source do not match the other. Leading required arguments are positional, e.g. tournament_matches('WTA', 901, 2026) for the 2026 Australian Open women's event.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
# ATP and WTA tennis

Rankings, tournament calendars, full draw results, Grand Slam finals, player profiles and player season logs, fetched on demand and returned as typed Arrow tables.

## Sources and ids

WTA data comes from the official WTA API. ATP data, live scoreboards and Grand Slam finals come from ESPN's undocumented endpoints. Player and tournament ids are specific to their `source`.

## Scores

`score` reads from the winner's side with the tiebreak loser's points in parentheses, e.g. `7-6(5) 6-3`. `sets` holds per-set games for side 1 and side 2.
rows.vgi.executable_examples: [{"name": "current_rankings_cover_both_tours", "description": "Singles rankings are present for both the ATP and WTA.", "sql": "SELECT count(DISTINCT tour) AS tours FROM tennis.main.current_rankings", "expected_result": [{"tours": 2}]}, {"name": "each_tour_has_a_number_one", "description": "Each tour has exactly one player ranked first.", "sql": "SELECT bool_and(n = 1) AS ok FROM (SELECT tour, count(*) AS n FROM tennis.main.current_rankings WHERE ranking = 1 GROUP BY tour)", "expected_result": [{"ok": true}]}, {"name": "current_matches_are_typed", "description": "Every current match has an id and a known status.", "sql": "SELECT coalesce(bool_and(match_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('scheduled','in_progress','completed','retired','walkover','other')), true) AS ok FROM tennis.main.current_matches", "expected_result": [{"ok": true}]}, {"name": "ao_2026_womens_champion", "description": "Elena Rybakina won the 2026 Australian Open women's singles final.", "sql": "SELECT winner_name FROM tennis.main.tournament_matches('WTA', 901, 2026) WHERE draw_type = 'singles' AND round = 'Final'", "expected_result": [{"winner_name": "Elena Rybakina"}]}]
